```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent1 "<!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Expanded Entity Text">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  %ent1;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Comment detailing complex namespace and entity interactions -->
  <sub:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like text: <root>&ent2;</root>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p_entity "<!ENTITY g_entity 'Global Entity Value'>">
  %p_entity;
  <!ENTITY ref "&g_entity; with suffix">
]>
<?target-pi processing instruction data with &ref; imitation?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Top-level documentation comment -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block: &ref;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block with raw tags: <item>nested</item>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; & MoreText">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docFile SYSTEM "spec.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % local_macro "<!ENTITY nested_macro 'DeepMacro'>">
  %local_macro;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<document xmlns="http://schema.example.net/doc" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment: Testing entity expansion inside CDATA and attributes -->
  <section xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="&base;">
    <![CDATA[
      Inside CDATA: &extended; and &nested_macro;
    ]]>
  </section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entA "Value A">
  <!ENTITY entB "Value B: &entA;">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY entC 'Value C'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY scan SYSTEM "scan.tiff" NDATA tiff>
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" mode="test"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Comment before complex structured sections -->
  <meta:record id="rec1">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw CDATA record containing &entB; and &entC;
    ]]>
  </meta:record>
  <meta:record id="rec2">&entB;</meta:record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY token "SecretToken">
  <!ENTITY combined "&token; - Extended">
  <!ENTITY % ext_macro "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>">
  %ext_macro;
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:store="http://inventory.org/ns/store">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment block with entities &token; -->
  <store:item code="X99">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with &combined; and unparsed markup <item>test</item>
    ]]>
  </store:item>
</inventory>
```
